# Scalar PBR producer fixture

`static-pbr-factors-v1.glb` is generated by the asset server's
`examples/static_pbr_fixture.rs` using its opt-in typed material policy at producer commit
`4035eacb582bbd268855dedf939fc2123082a722`.
It contains no native game assets. Regenerate and decode both sides with
`scripts/check-static-pbr-fixture.sh CLIENT_CHECKOUT PRODUCER_CHECKOUT`.
The conformance workflow pins the producer revision independently of the older
`static-visual-v1.glb` fixture.

The five dome meshes share one base color and have seven placements, including
two rotated/scaled instances of the first mesh. Left to right, the materials are
matte dielectric, smooth dielectric, rough metal, smooth metal and explicit
`KHR_materials_unlit`. Tests assert the decoded factors and shared mesh identity;
GPU tests check actual shading separately. The fixture requires reader 2 and
`pbr-metallic-roughness-factors-v1` plus `static-visual-v1`.

The binary is 90,140 bytes. SHA-256:
`4bf80d3439a23e07cac7d983b4d2b1c48f6139179649725fbd9b906736e324cf`.

This regeneration omits empty optional `images` and `textures` arrays to satisfy
glTF validation. The binary geometry payload and standard materials are unchanged.
